contract: Road user a is following road user b at the observation: b is ahead of a in the same lane along that lane's direction of travel, and the two bodies' headings are aligned within the same-direction tolerance, a cosine the caller sets. It is a relation of place and direction at the observation; it states no gap, no speed, no duration and no intention. Not a stand-in for: the size of the space between the two — a caller that bounds a space reads the gap atom itself — overtaking or passing, two road users abreast in neighbouring lanes, or a towed combination, which is one road user drawn by another.

params.name: same_direction_tolerance
params.meaning: the cosine of the largest angle between the two headings still read as the same direction, a ratio between minus one and one

elements.span: b is ahead of a in the same lane along that lane's direction of travel
elements.justification: rel.ahead_behind_in_lane is “a is ahead of / behind b in the same lane, along the lane direction”, which is exactly the ordering and the frame this contract states; no other atom carries an in-lane order, rel.bearing giving only a direction in the subject's frame.

elements.span: the two bodies' headings are aligned within the same-direction tolerance
elements.justification: rel.same_direction is “headings aligned: the cosine of the angle between the headings is above its tolerance, which is the cosine of the largest angle allowed, a ratio between -1 and 1”; the tolerance is the atom's own parameter, which this concept exposes as its formal parameter.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: A car runs in the same lane as a van, 30 m behind it, both headings within a few degrees of each other along the lane.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: The car runs abreast of the van in the neighbouring lane: neither is ahead of the other in the same lane.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: The same pair with the source declaring the in-lane order of road users absent: whether the van is ahead of the car in its lane cannot be read.
